title: Phase 2 Entry Hardening: Enforce Candle Rejection or MACD Confirmation on 61.8% Fibonacci Entries
research_question: Does requiring candle rejection or MACD directional confirmation on 61.8% Fibonacci retracement entries (InpRequire618Rejection = true) eliminate false breakout entries and improve overall system win rate and profitability across both 5-year training and 2026 UNSEEN partitions?
hypothesis: In previous experiments (e.g., EXP-0057, EXP-0059, EXP-0061, EXP-0063), 61.8% short entries suffered a 0% win rate (0 wins, 6 losses, -$591.00 net loss) because the baseline Confirmed() function bypassed candle rejection and MACD filters for 61.8% entries, relying solely on RSI. Enabling InpRequire618Rejection will filter out unconfirmed 61.8% entries into strong momentum thrusts, reducing drawdowns and improving trade quality without impairing overall system profitability.

facts: In EXP-0057 and EXP-0059, 100% of 61.8% short entries failed (6/6 losses, -$591.00 loss) due to blind RSI-only entry at the 61.8% level without price rejection.
In EXP-0062 (repaired ResetWeek, 2020-2024 Training), the EA achieved 37 trades with 48.65% win rate and -$883.06 net profit.
In EXP-0063 (repaired ResetWeek, 2026 UNSEEN), the EA achieved +$259.33 net profit, PF 1.23, 56.0% win rate across 25 trades.
inferences: Blindly entering at the 61.8% level when price is exhibiting strong momentum produces false reversal signals.
Requiring candle rejection (wick ratio >= 0.35) or MACD confirmation will eliminate low-probability 61.8% entries and protect capital.
evidence: Forensic trade breakdown in EXP-0057/EXP-0059 confirmed 0% win rate on 618_S trades.
EXP-0063 recorded gross loss of -$1118.24, partially contributed by unconfirmed 61.8% entries.

independent_variables.name: InpRequire618Rejection
independent_variables.rationale: Requires candle rejection or MACD confirmation for 61.8% Fibonacci entries, harmonizing confirmation standards with the 50.0% level.

assumptions: Candle rejection or MACD confirmation will filter toxic counter-trend entries without discarding high-quality turning points.
The 61.8% level functions more reliably when accompanied by price action confirmation.
expected_observations: Reduction of unconfirmed losing 61.8% entries in backtest history.
Improvement in overall win rate and reduction in gross loss.
falsification_conditions: Overall trade count drops below 10 trades across the 5-year training period.
